name: Bún chả Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Bún chả Hà Nội. An artisanal ceramic bowl of warm, amber-colored fish sauce broth filled with charcoal-grilled ground pork patties (chả viên) and caramelized pork belly slices (chả miếng) with charred grill marks, garnished with sliced pickled green papaya and carrots. Served alongside a clean white plate of fresh soft rice vermicelli (bún) and a wicker basket of fresh herbs (perilla, Vietnamese coriander, crisp lettuce). A small ceramic dish of minced garlic, lime wedges, and sliced red bird's eye chilies on the side. Set on a rustic dark wooden table with soft natural side lighting, subtle steam rising, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, editorial food magazine style.

name: Bún đậu mắm tôm
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of an authentic Vietnamese Bún đậu mắm tôm platter. Arranged on a round woven bamboo tray lined with a clean green banana leaf: golden crispy deep-fried tofu cubes with crunchy crust and soft interior, slices of boiled pork shank, fragrant fried green rice pork patties (chả cốm), crispy pork spring rolls, and neatly cut square blocks of pressed rice vermicelli (bún lá). In the center is a small ceramic bowl of frothy violet shrimp paste (mắm tôm) topped with hot oil, squeezed kumquat juice, and minced red chili. Fresh herbs like Vietnamese perilla and mint on the side. Rustic dark wooden table, warm ambient restaurant lighting, 8k resolution, mouth-watering editorial style.

name: Chả cá Lã Vọng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Hanoi Chả cá Lã Vọng. A sizzling small cast-iron skillet on a portable wooden burner, filled with golden turmeric-marinated catfish nuggets sizzled in aromatic oil, smothered in an abundant heap of vibrant green fresh dill (thì là) and curly scallion curls. Served with a bowl of soft white rice vermicelli, roasted golden peanuts, and a small dipping bowl of whisked shrimp paste with lime and chili. Gentle aromatic steam rising from the hot skillet. Rustic dark wooden tabletop, atmospheric dining illumination, 8k resolution, gourmet culinary presentation.

name: Bún ốc Hà Nội
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hanoi Snail Noodle Soup (Bún ốc Hà Nội). A large handmade rustic ceramic bowl filled with steaming, fragrant, tangy broth made from natural wine vinegar (giấm bỗng) and ripe red tomato wedges. Plump, glistening, crunchy freshwater snails (ốc nhồi) and golden crispy fried tofu puffs resting atop soft white rice vermicelli. Garnished with finely chopped purple perilla leaves (tía tô) and scallions, with a spoonful of aromatic chili oil (ớt chưng) floating on the surface. Rustic wooden table, beautiful culinary steam, natural side lighting, 8k resolution, mouth-watering food photography.

name: Mì Quảng tôm thịt
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Mì Quảng tôm thịt. A wide artisanal ceramic bowl with wide turmeric-infused bright yellow rice noodles, braised savory sweet whole prawns and caramelized pork belly slices, hard-boiled quail egg. Topped with crushed roasted peanuts and crispy fried scallions. A large piece of toasted sesame rice cracker (bánh tráng mè nướng) tucked into the bowl. A shallow pool of rich, concentrated, flavorful pork-shrimp broth at the bottom. Served with fresh banana blossom shreds, mustard greens, lime and green chili on a dark wooden table. Soft side lighting, 8k resolution, gourmet editorial style.

name: Cơm gà Hội An
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Hội An Chicken Rice (Cơm gà Hội An). A beautiful rustic plate featuring a mound of fragrant golden rice cooked in chicken fat and turmeric broth, topped with shredded free-range chicken tossed with Vietnamese coriander (rau răm), paper-thin white onion slices, and crushed black pepper. Accompanied by sweet-and-sour pickled shredded papaya and carrot, a small bowl of savory chicken giblet gravy, and a spicy homemade chili jam. Dark vintage wooden table, soft warm daylight, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, mouth-watering restaurant presentation.

name: Cao lầu Hội An
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Hội An Cao lầu noodles. A deep rustic earthenware bowl of thick, chewy, brownish-yellow traditional noodles made with Cham island firewood ash. Topped with sliced five-spice braised char siu pork loin with glistening caramelized edges, golden crispy fried square noodle croutons (tóp mỡ / ram), fresh Tra Que aromatic herbs, and blanched bean sprouts. A spoonful of rich, savory, spiced pork braising reduction at the base. Rustic wooden table background, warm directional lighting, 8k resolution, authentic Hoi An specialty.

name: Bún chả cá Nha Trang
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Nha Trang Fish Cake Noodle Soup (Bún chả cá Nha Trang). A large ceramic bowl of steaming, crystal-clear, sweet savory broth simmered from fresh sea fish bones and pineapple wedges. Filled with rice vermicelli, slices of golden deep-fried mackerel fish cake (chả cá chiên) and tender steamed fish cake (chả cá hấp), garnished with chopped scallions and cilantro. On the side, a small plate of finely shredded lettuce, herbs, and a dish of spicy sweet fish sauce dip with bird's eye chilies. Dark wooden table, rising steam, natural lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh bột lọc Huế
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Huế Tapioca Dumplings (Bánh bột lọc). A ceramic plate stacked with crystal-clear, translucent, chewy tapioca dumplings clearly showing the whole pink braised sea shrimp and pork belly filling inside. Drizzled with glossy scallion oil (mỡ hành) and crispy fried shallots. Served with a small ceramic saucer of sweet-savory fish sauce swimming with thinly sliced fresh red bird's eye chilies. Rustic dark wood surface, glistening highlights, high detail texture, 8k resolution, editorial food magazine style.

name: Bánh căn xíu mại
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Dalat style Bánh căn xíu mại. A platter of golden-crisp round mini rice pancakes (bánh căn) with soft pillowy centers and sunny quail egg yolks baked inside. Beside it, a steaming rustic ceramic bowl of savory broth with juicy pork meatballs (xíu mại), filled with floating chopped scallion oil and shredded green mango. Small side plate of fresh herbs. Rustic wooden table, inviting steam rising from the soup, warm cozy morning lighting, 8k resolution, gourmet presentation.

name: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of iconic Saigon Broken Rice (Cơm tấm sườn bì chả). A large ceramic plate with fragrant steamed broken rice, topped with a huge, succulent, charcoal-grilled pork chop (sườn nướng) with glossy caramelized glaze and appetizing char marks. Accompanied by savory shredded pork skin (bì), a golden square slice of steamed egg and pork meatloaf (chả trứng), and a sunny-side-up fried egg with a runny orange yolk. Drizzled with scallion oil (mỡ hành) and served with pickled daikon and carrots, cucumber slices, and a small glass bowl of sweet garlic-chili fish sauce. Rustic wood table, 8k resolution, editorial food photography.

name: Bánh mì thịt nướng
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of an authentic Vietnamese Grilled Pork Baguette (Bánh mì thịt nướng). A golden, ultra-crispy Vietnamese baguette sliced open, packed generously with tender lemongrass-marinated grilled pork skewers boasting caramelized grill marks, pickled daikon radish and carrots (đồ chua), fresh crunchy cucumber spears, cilantro sprigs, and a drizzle of rich savory sauce and spicy chili. Resting on parchment paper over a rustic dark wooden table. Warm natural side lighting, crisp bread crumbs scattered naturally, 8k resolution, magazine cover quality.

name: Hủ tiếu Nam Vang
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Vietnamese Nam Vang Dry Noodles (Hủ tiếu Nam Vang khô). A ceramic bowl of chewy clear tapioca noodles tossed in a rich dark sweet-savory soy sauce. Elegantly topped with poached whole pink prawns, tender sliced char siu pork, savory minced pork, quail eggs, crispy golden fried garlic bits, and fresh Chinese celery and chives. Beside it, a small steaming bowl of clear, rich pork bone broth with sliced pork heart and liver. Rustic dark wooden table, soft directional lighting, 8k resolution, gourmet food photography.

name: Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of Vietnamese Fresh Summer Spring Rolls (Gỏi cuốn tôm thịt). Five tightly wrapped translucent rice paper rolls neatly arranged on a ceramic serving dish, showing bright pink whole poached shrimp, tender pork belly slices, soft white rice vermicelli, and vibrant green mint and chives inside. Served with a small ceramic bowl of rich dark peanut hoisin dipping sauce topped with crushed golden roasted peanuts and red chili paste. Rustic wooden table, fresh herbs, natural lighting, crisp and mouth-watering, 8k resolution.

name: Bò kho bánh mì
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Beef Stew (Bò kho bánh mì). A rustic dark ceramic bowl filled with rich, velvety, aromatic reddish-orange stew featuring tender braised beef shank and tendon cubes with carrot flowers, infused with lemongrass, star anise, and cinnamon. Garnished with fresh Thai basil leaves and chopped culantro (ngò gai). Served with a warm, golden-brown crusty Vietnamese baguette (bánh mì) and a small saucer of salt, pepper, and lime wedge. Rustic wooden table, rising steam, warm evening dining lighting, 8k resolution.

name: Bánh xèo miền Tây
prompt: Professional culinary food photography of authentic Vietnamese Bánh xèo miền Tây (giant Mekong Delta crispy sizzling crepe). A huge golden-yellow turmeric and coconut milk crepe with delicate, paper-thin, bubbly, frilly, ultra-crispy lace-like edges, folded in half, revealing plump pink shrimp, tender slices of pork belly, and crisp fresh bean sprouts inside. Resting on a traditional round woven bamboo tray lined with a glossy green banana leaf. Beside the platter is a generous basket of fresh Vietnamese herbs: broad green mustard leaves (cải bẹ xanh), fresh mint, and perilla leaves. Next to it, an artisanal ceramic bowl containing glowing amber-colored sweet and sour fish sauce with minced red chilies and pickled carrots. Rustic dark wooden table, warm natural lighting, subtle steam, 8k resolution, editorial food magazine style.
